estimate_assumptions.included_probe: Actual tapered metal reference, modeled as steel
estimate_assumptions.controller_mass: Unknown and excluded. Controller reservation and keepout helpers are reference volumes, not mass-bearing assembly parts. Estimates cover the 48-part stage only; actual controller, heatsink and cable mass will add gravity torque.
estimate_assumptions.motor_centroid_note: 270/9/1 g body/face/shaft allocation is an assumption, not a measured motor mass distribution.
estimate_assumptions.print_note: 100%-solid CAD equivalent; lower uniform fractions are sensitivity cases and are not slicer infill percentages.
estimate_assumptions.limitations: Static gravity only. No acceleration, contact force, cable load, material anisotropy, stress, clamp slip or stiffness validation.

controller_mass_sensitivity.note: A sensitivity coefficient only, using the center of the reference reservation box. Actual controller/heatsink/cable mass and center of mass are unknown. Add its torque vector to the stage vector before taking the bending-moment norm; do not add moment norms.

method.source_centroids: Neutral-angle exact build123d volume centroids; source motion rules move each centroid rigidly; world transform taken from source. Crosschecked against 41 independently rebuilt CAD poses.
method.peak_method: 401 uniform wheel-angle samples across the full 0-40 mm lift, then bounded numerical refinement of every detected local maximum; endpoints included. Static estimate, not a structural validation.
method.fair_comparison: Each source uses identical assumed densities and purchased masses, and its own full 0–40 mm stroke peak. The 0/20/40 mm poses also compare corresponding physical lift heights.
method.sensitivity_cases: Uniform 60% and 35% material fractions are sensitivity estimates, not slicer infill percentages. Actual shells and infill can change mass and centroid.

motor_properties_at_lift_20_mm.note: Complete assumed 280 g motor COM is used for each version, with 270/9/1 g body/front-face/shaft allocation. v3 turns the rear tangentially away from the barrel and reserves 20 mm behind it; unknown controller/heatsink/cable mass is excluded.

display.assumptions: Compared with v1. Static gravity peak over 0–40 mm, estimated from 401 poses with bounded refinement; PETG 1.27 g/cm³ at 100% solid fraction (solid-equivalent estimate); assumed 280 g motor in all versions. Steel hardware 7.85 g/cm³; 625ZZ bearings 5 g each. Modeled metal probe included; microscope and specimen excluded. Controller, heatsink and cable mass is unknown and excluded; reserved controller boxes are reference space only. Actual print mass depends on material and toolpaths; this is not a structural load rating.
